jobs.description:
Robert Half is currently recruiting a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) - Antwerp.

Our client is an innovative organization with a long-term vision and a strong commitment to sustainable value creation. You will join a collaborative finance environment where strategy, finance and entrepreneurship come together in support of lasting growth.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) include:

• You support the day-to-day accounting activities across multiple group entities and help ensure financial records are accurate, complete and up to date.
• You process invoices, bank transactions and journal entries, and contribute to the monthly, quarterly and annual closing processes.
• You assist in monitoring balance sheet accounts and help maintain a high level of financial accuracy and compliance.
• You contribute to the preparation of periodic financial reports for internal and external stakeholders.
• You support the preparation of statutory financial statements, audit documentation, reconciliations and balance sheet analyses.
• You help optimize and standardize accounting and financial processes within an evolving finance organization.
• You support the implementation of internal controls and accounting policies to strengthen the control environment and improve efficiency.
• You assist with finance-related projects, analyses and administrative tasks, and provide support to colleagues with financial questions.
 

 

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in accountancy, Finance or a related field, combined with around three years of relevant professional experience.
• You have strong technical skills and an excellent command of Microsoft Excel.
• You have experience with SAP or another ERP system, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have a basic knowledge of IFRS, which is an advantage.
• You have an interest in or experience with real estate and/or private equity structures.
• You are analytical, accurate, proactive and eager to learn.
• You work well in a team and communicate smoothly with colleagues.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

The Logistics Centre in Grimbergen is recognized as one of the world's leading facilities, reflecting the company's commitment to excellence across all operations.

Jobomschrijving

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed
• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks
• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations
• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background
• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)
• Hands-on and dynamic approach
• Precision and results-oriented mindset
• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility
• Team player who can also work independently
• Preferably experienced in welding
• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

CONCRETE WORKER – BORNEM – FULLTIME DAILY HOURSAt Manpower, we are looking for a Concrete Worker for a hands-on production environment where you see real results every day. As a Concrete Worker, you work in a fixed team where colleagues know each other and help out. The workplace is a concrete workshop with clear workstations and practical equipment. What makes this Concrete Worker job different? You receive on-the-job training so you can gradually take on more responsibilities.
Jobomschrijving

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

• You help produce precast concrete elements.
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
• You can work both independently and in a team.
• You work safely and in an orderly way.
Nice-to-haves

• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - Medior Business Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
• Position: Business Functional Analyst

• Domain: Business Analysis / IT & Application Projects

• Seniority: Medior (3-5 years of experience)

• Working environment: Collaboration with business stakeholders, IT teams, Project Managers and external partners.

• Location : Bruxelles

• English: Fluent.

• Fluent in French and/or Dutch

Business Functional Analyst

We are looking for an experienced Business Functional Analyst to join an established team and help translate business needs into effective technology solutions.

In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, Project Managers, IT teams, external partners and vendors to understand business challenges, clarify requirements and support the successful delivery of functional solutions.

You will play a key role throughout the project lifecycle, from initial analysis and requirements gathering to solution design, testing, implementation and post-go-live support.

You combine strong analytical and communication skills with a pragmatic mindset. Beyond documenting business requests, you seek to understand the underlying needs, challenge assumptions constructively and contribute to defining the right solutions.
Key responsibilities

• Business & functional analysis:

• Facilitate workshops, interviews and working sessions with business stakeholders to understand objectives, challenges and requirements.

• Analyse and document current and future business processes, business rules, data flows and system interactions.

• Challenge business requests where appropriate and translate needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria.

• Assess impacts, dependencies and risks, ensuring alignment between business objectives, technical feasibility and project scope.

• Functional design & documentation:

• Create process models, functional design documents, data mappings, mock-ups and prototypes where needed.

• Support solution design and collaborate closely with development, architecture, vendor and testing teams to define fit-for-purpose solutions.

• Maintain clear functional documentation and requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

• Bridge between business & IT:

• Act as a key point of contact for functional questions throughout design, development, testing and implementation.

• Work closely with Project Managers, Developers and Test Engineers, supporting scope clarification, impact assessments, dependencies and requirement-related risks.

• Ensure that decisions and requirements are clearly understood across business and IT teams, from initial analysis through deployment.

• Testing & validation:

• Prepare functional test scenarios and support regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), in collaboration with the Test Engineer.

• Support business users during UAT and validate that delivered solutions meet agreed business and functional requirements.

• Analyse defects and root causes with business and technical teams and contribute to appropriate corrective actions.

• Continuous improvement:

• Proactively identify process improvements, automation opportunities and system enhancements.

• Support change and rollout activities, including documentation, training materials and business readiness where required.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions and help shape the evolution of the application landscape.

Professional experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience

• 3-5 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst or similar analytical and process-oriented IT project role

• Proven experience in requirements analysis, functional design or software implementation

• Hands-on experience with business process modelling and functional documentation, including use cases, user stories and acceptance criteria

• Experience supporting end-to-end solution delivery

 

Technical & functional knowledge:

• Familiarity with tools and systems such as:

• 

• Azure DevOps

• Confluence

• ERP solutions

• Microsoft 365

• Comfortable working with data-related concepts, integrations and APIs

• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into clear functional requirements

• Experience supporting testing and validation activities

Personal profile

We are looking for someone who is:

• Analytical, structured and solution-oriented

• Self-motivated, curious and proactive

• Flexible and comfortable adapting to change

• Able to anticipate needs, ask the right questions and challenge assumptions constructively

• Capable of bringing structure to ambiguous situations

• Reliable and able to manage priorities effectively

• Comfortable moving between business discussions and detailed functional conversations with IT teams

• An effective communicator who can manage complex stakeholder interactions diplomatically and professionally

• Collaborative, with a strong team spirit and willingness to share knowledge

• Interested in continuous learning and professional development

Why join Skechers?

• A fast-growing international company
• A warm, dynamic, and tech-forward work environment
• A culture that embraces diversity and inclusion
• A competitive salary package

To strengthen its operational team, our client Skechers is currently looking for an Operations Manager for its site in Herstal.

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

• A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
• An international and multilingual setting
• An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
• A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)
Access and security

• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)
Hardware and lifecycle

• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
• Tickets, escalation and coordination
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity
Assets

• Knowledge of Arabic
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
• IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)
Soft skills

• Customer focus and service mindset
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management
• Clear communication with non-technical users
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.Key ResponsibilitiesGovernance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.
Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.
Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.
HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.
Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.
External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

ProfileWe are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

A leading international food manufacturer which operates in a fast-moving consumer goods environment and manages a portfolio of well-known consumer brands with strong market recognition.The organization places a strong emphasis on sustainability, quality, and consumer-centric strategies.In Belgium, it collaborates closely with major retailers, distributors, and foodservice partners to strengthen its market presence.

• At least 3 years of experience in Key Account Management, Category management, Trade Marketing or Customer Development within FMCG sector.
• Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Highly results-oriented with a proactive and entrepreneurial approach.
• Fluent in French or Dutch with a good comprehension of the other national language. English mandatory.
